project.title: Simple Pendulum - Time in Motion | Sakura Atelier v2
project.audience: Grade 11 mechanics learners and teachers; optional Grade 12 connections/enrichment
project.outcome: Collect measured periods, estimate g from a graph and explain approximation, damping and measurement error.

identity.composition: Ivory architectural opening, brass pendulum, rose editorial title, focused laboratory and field notebook
identity.interaction: Drag or keyboard-position a bob, release, time, record and compare
identity.signature: An analytic small-angle ghost diverges from the true nonlinear motion; actual observations replay their conditions
identity.distinction: A rebuilt warm editorial mechanics experience rather than the original navy observatory; expanded phase, uncertainty and Grade 12 connection panels.

model.scope: Nonlinear released-from-rest point-mass pendulum, angular damping; linearized ghost and separate advanced calculators
model.units: SI metres, seconds, kilograms, radians; UI angles in degrees
model.state: theta, omega, simulated time, independently integrated heat, validated parameters; separate observations and assessed answers
assumptions: Massless, inextensible suspension and point bob; fixed support and uniform gravity
Release limited to +/-80 degrees from rest to remain in the taut-string oscillatory domain
No external driving or electric force in the main motion; advanced calculators are explicitly separate
limitations: No air flow, finite bob inertia or support motion
Real-world timing uncertainty is user-assumed, not a confidence interval or noise simulation

invariants.statement: Mass does not alter the motion at fixed gamma; energy and forces scale with mass
invariants.oracle: Independent equation cancellation and numerical mass cases

invariants.statement: Period is a full same-direction crossing interval in simulated seconds
invariants.oracle: Known small-angle period, independently integrated finite-angle period and crossing interpolation cases

invariants.statement: K+U+Q is conserved to numerical error under viscous angular damping
invariants.oracle: Independent heat rate and energy diagnostics, timestep convergence
